corrections.proposed: 1937 is the register's Built field; the same entry says the planned tower was never built. A temporary tent lookout was announced in 1939 and a ground cabin is reported built in 1954.
corrections.why: The register's own description says the tower was never built, so 1937 as a built lookout is contradicted by its source.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1937 and calls the timber tower never built; a Klamath chronology records a May 13, 1939 announcement of a temporary tent lookout; the register's only photo shows a ground cabin reported built in 1954. The story reports these as separate claims, not one confirmed lookout.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, and they disagree on what was built. Searches returned nothing else about this lookout: hits for Lakeview Point were Lake Mead-area photos, and Lake Mountain is a different Klamath lookout. A 1958 Klamath forest eligibility report may cover this site but was not fetched. The brief's 1937 build year is contested by the register's own description.
